summary: Abuse protection: UrlValidator refuses blocklisted domains at creation (400 invalid-url, reason BLOCKED_DOMAIN, configured under shortener.abuse.*); admins flag links with POST /api/v1/admin/links/{code}/flag (403 for other keys); Flyway V3 adds status FLAGGED, and a flagged link answers 451 link-unavailable, with the cache evicted after the flag commits.
